nodes.label: EMBEDDING_DIM 1536 coupling to text-embedding-3-small
nodes.rationale: VECTOR(1536) column size must match the configured embedding model.

nodes.label: Deployment (Railway / Fly.io)
nodes.rationale: Both need a pgvector Postgres and user-owned accounts; deploy left to the user to avoid creating paid resources.

nodes.label: Lazy OpenAI Client Construction
nodes.rationale: get_client() builds the client on first use so importing llm.py never requires a valid API key (tests run without credentials).

nodes.label: No LLM Framework Principle
nodes.rationale: Avoid LangChain/LangGraph/CrewAI so every abstraction can be read top to bottom; 'prove you understand the fundamentals' before adopting frameworks.

nodes.label: RAG from Scratch (pgvector)
nodes.rationale: chunk -> embed -> store in pgvector -> cosine (<=>) search -> context-only prompt with [source:index] citations. pgvector chosen so retrieval is one SQL query with no separate vector DB service; no reranking/metadata filtering by design as a learning baseline.

nodes.label: Raw Agent Loop (no framework)
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled bounded loop instead of LangChain/LangGraph/CrewAI so the fundamentals are readable and framework-based agents are easier to debug later.

nodes.label: Router-boundary Mocking in Tests
nodes.rationale: Tests monkeypatch router-level functions (e.g. app.routers.qualify.qualify_lead) so the suite needs no API key or network; enables CI with a dummy key.

nodes.label: Secrets Hygiene (env vars via config.py)
nodes.rationale: app/config.py is the only place env vars are read; .env git-ignored, .env.example documents required vars; switching provider/DB needs only .env changes.

nodes.label: Structured Outputs
nodes.rationale: chat.completions.parse(response_format=PydanticModel) validates model JSON before app code sees it, so malformed answers fail loudly instead of silently corrupting records.

nodes.label: Tool Use / Function Calling Loop
nodes.rationale: Model returns tool_calls; code executes local function, appends role:tool message, repeats until no more tool calls, then requests final structured answer. This is the mechanism every agent framework wraps.

nodes.label: Paragraph-aware Chunking with Overlap
nodes.rationale: ~800-char chunks keep retrieval specific; 100-char overlap prevents answers being split across a chunk boundary.

nodes.label: Mocked CRM/Enrichment Tools (Acme Corp, Globex)
nodes.rationale: Stand-ins for Apollo/Clay/HubSpot; swapping in a real API would only touch the two tool functions, not the loop.

nodes.label: Prompt Engineering for Reliability
nodes.rationale: System prompts (QUALIFY/ASK/AGENT) exist to constrain format and behavior (score range, answer only from context, call tool at most once).
